meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 给 Claude 装上 DeltaChat 渠道:它直接驱动 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server 子进程,通过电子邮件收发消息,并支持端到端加密。可在 DeltaChat 私聊和群组中对话,支持收发文件附件。
howto.when: 当你想给项目添加 DeltaChat 渠道,或补齐缺失的适配器文件与依赖时使用。安装步骤是幂等的,已就绪的部分会自动跳过。

say.text: 帮我添加 DeltaChat 渠道并安装适配器
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑校验测试

say.text: 把 DeltaChat 的邀请链接找出来,我要扫码加机器人
say.note: 会从日志取 invite link 并给出二维码文件路径

say.text: 把 DeltaChat 群组接到我的 agent 上

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel to Claude: it drives the @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server subprocess directly, sending and receiving email messages with end-to-end encryption. Works in DeltaChat DMs and groups, with file attachments both ways.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add the DeltaChat channel to your project, or fill in missing adapter files and the pinned dependency. Steps already in place are skipped.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel and install the adapter for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the package, runs the test

say_en.text: Find the DeltaChat invite link so I can scan the QR code
say_en.note: Reads the invite link from logs and points to the QR SVG

say_en.text: Wire my DeltaChat group to an agent
say_en.note: Guides you through /manage-channels or ncl wiring
